brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 4, Edmund meets the White Witch on her sledge. Build the sledge stop, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each line from the book and tap who said it. Then finish two sentences about telling the truth.
extra: Add four Snowballs, one for each child the Witch asks about. Say why she wants all four.
step1: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the deer in the snow. Put the crown up high beside it. Put the bottle, cup and box in the snow.
step4: Point to the crown and say this out loud. The Witch was nice to Edmund because… He should not trust her because…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
